items.name: contract
items.title: fcs contract params
items.description: Default params module. Overwritten by `fcs build` from your .design/ contract.

items.name: textarea-field
items.title: TextareaField
items.description: Labelled textarea with hint and error. Resize behaviour comes from rule forms.textarea.resize.

items.name: async-boundary
items.title: AsyncBoundary
items.description: Suspense + error boundary and PageSkeleton. Skeleton vs spinner and delay come from rule loading.page.

items.name: page
items.title: Page
items.description: Page frame and PageHeader (title, breadcrumb, actions). Width and breadcrumb behaviour come from rules layout.page-template and layout.page-header.

items.name: list-page
items.title: ListPage
items.description: List screen template: Page header, toolbar row, list content.
